notes: Variant assumption is a standing bilateral dumbbell shrug with arms at the sides and straight-up scapular elevation. The direct evidence emphasizes upper trapezius, but the local anatomy map exposes only a broader Trapezius entry, so that mapped label is used. No secondary or support muscles are listed because adding grip, levator scapulae, or general postural stabilizers would either lack a local mesh or add weak visible app value.
